notes:
Update 1.2.6.
• Bundled mod is now VOID Client 2.1.0 (was 0.2.2).
• Spotify HUD is a real now-playing widget: cover art, a progress bar with elapsed and total time, a scrolling title, and the album name.
• New FPS graph with spike highlighting, plus a session timer in the clock box.
• Fixed the shield colour-tint injection, which never applied in 0.2.2.
• Auto-update now reads the project's own feed, so future releases reach every existing install.
